summary: Security applicability is applicable. The phase diff is provenance-bound to d8e08cde..1f266be2 and the audited HEAD is current. Fail-closed behavior, the role variables, the PII flag, usage-record hygiene, F1 recovery, and F10 redaction are implemented and pass my own targeted runs (12/12 role cases, 4/4 F1, 2/2 F10, both no-PII guards 1 passed each). One blocking test-contract violation remains: Red case 8 asserts substring text where the strategy requires the reason field (A1). Four nonblocking findings: the S1 OPENROUTER_DEBUG gap is still open, the S2 Verify grep will match the case-9 test fixture lines, the two-role cache isolation test is missing, and no test imports the new exports from the package surface.
blocking_findings: B1 [Blocker] review-b: Red case 8 asserts substring text, not the reason field. packages/ai-tutoring/src/__tests__/roles.test.ts:169 uses toContain("preset") on joined log lines. test-strategy.md S2.4 case 8 requires asserting the reason field, and S2.11 row A1 names includes('preset') as the exact pattern that fails review. The behavior is correct in code (roles.ts:48-49 returns reason 'preset'), so the fix is test-only: parse the logged JSON record and assert reason === 'preset', as cases 3 and 11 already do. Route to Green.
nonblocking_findings: N1 [Major] review-b: The S1 Review B OPENROUTER_DEBUG finding is still open after S2. packages/ai-tutoring/src/openrouter-client.ts:18-27 passes no debugLogger, so a Worker variable OPENROUTER_DEBUG=1 makes the SDK log the authorization header and the request and response bodies (node_modules/@openrouter/sdk/esm/lib/sdks.js:59-62). No repository file sets the flag, so the risk stays latent. Spec D9 keeps the no-PII rule. Default: fix in S3 by passing a no-op debugLogger and adding a test with OPENROUTER_DEBUG=1.

N2 [Nit] review-b: The S2 Verify command git grep 'OPENROUTER_MODEL\b\|openrouter/free' -- apps packages ':!**/.env.example' will match packages/ai-tutoring/src/__tests__/roles.test.ts:51, :172, and :174. These lines are the case-9 fixture that proves the old variable is not used. My grep confirms no production code matches either pattern. Default: the verifier records the three test-file matches as the live complement of the artifact check and does not block on them.

N3 [Nit] review-b: No test resolves two roles and asserts the second role keeps its own model. test-strategy.md S2.7 names this guardrail: a test that resolves two roles must fail when the second returns the first role's model. The implementation uses a Map keyed by AiRole (providers.ts:385-387), correct by inspection, and case 1 covers one role only. Default: add the two-role cache isolation test in S3, which edits the resolvers again.

N4 [Nit] review-b: No package test imports the four new exports (AI_ROLES, AiRole, resolveRoleModel, buildProviderPreferences) from src/index.ts. test-strategy.md S2.10 names this complement row. The role tests import from ../roles directly, and no app uses the new exports yet, so an index wiring error is invisible to every test. Default: import the new exports from the package surface in an S3 test.

Security applicability: applicable. test-strategy.md S2.2 names the security review with the reason that fail-closed behavior is a privacy boundary and usage logging must not leak text. The range changes roles.ts, usage-log.ts, providers.ts, both chatbot routes, spreadsheet-feedback.ts, and both .env.example files.

PII flag: roles.ts:9-25 holds AI_ROLES with sendsPii false for studentTutor, spreadsheetEval, and accountingEval. Case 4 passes in my run. No role sets zdr today, so no request sends a provider object for PII (case 12).

zdr and require_parameters mapping: roles.ts:67-83 maps the four input pairs to undefined, {requireParameters}, {zdr}, and both. The SDK TypeScript field names requireParameters and zdr match node_modules/@openrouter/sdk/esm/models/providerpreferences.d.ts:123 and :131, and the outbound JSON uses snake_case per the same file line 179. Strategy F13 and evidence.md 'SDK API' record this.

Usage logs: usage-log.ts:12-31 holds role, model, latencyMs, promptTokens, completionTokens, totalTokens, outcome, and status only. No key, prompt, or answer field exists in the record type. providers.ts:248-285 writes one record after success and one after the last retry, with the served model on success and the requested model on failure. Neither is a secret.

Log-marker guard: my run of the 'role configuration' filter passes case 11: no log line holds PROMPT-MARKER-7 or ANSWER-MARKER-9, and the failed request logs outcome 'error' with status 503 (roles.test.ts:190-228).

F10 redaction: providers.ts:52-53 strips the bearer scheme with /^bearer\s+/i, so case and extra spaces do not matter. redactionTargets (providers.ts:44-56) covers the raw, trimmed, and token forms with the 8-character minimum. My F10 filter run passes F10a and F10b; my F1 filter run passes all four cases.

Every mapSdkError path returns redacted or fixed text: the HTTP path (providers.ts:96-102), the connection path (:109-116), the string rejection (:92-93), and the fallback (:118). The EmptyResponseError and body-read branches return new errors with no upstream text (:76-87).
No secrets in env examples: the range's .env.example diffs hold commented variable names, the openrouter/free development note, and placeholder text only. No key value appears in either file.

Fail closed: resolveRoleModel (roles.ts:39-53) rejects absent, empty, whitespace, and @preset/ values. Both resolvers return null and log the missing name through logRoleNotConfigured (usage-log.ts:29-31). Both chatbot routes keep the 503 fixed body, and spreadsheet-feedback.ts keeps the deterministic fallback when the resolver returns null. Cases 6 to 10 pass in my run.

Route input validation: unchanged by this range. Both routes keep the session claims check, profile lookup, enrollment check, rate limit, body validation, sanitizeInput, and detectPromptInjection before the provider call (IM3 route.ts:100-177 before :209). The BM2 route now resolves the provider inside its try block (route.ts:183), which closes the prior S1 Review B F3. retry.ts:51 reads the structured status field before message text, which closes the prior S1 Review B F2 mechanism.
A2 consent-blind publish gate: not applicable. The range flips no draft-to-published status and publishes nothing.

A6 registry overstatement: measure/tracks.md:243-247 marks the track open and describes planned phases only; no security state is claimed as resolved. Every evidence.md S2 claim names a log that exists under measure/runs/openrouter-sdk-ai-layer_20261114/, and my own runs reproduce the targeted results.

Test-contract integrity: git diff 8e803b83..1f266be2 -- roles.test.ts is empty, so no Red role assertion changed. The providers.test.ts changes are the planned signature updates; the removed 'uses custom model from OPENROUTER_MODEL' test is replaced by case 9, which asserts the old variable is not used.
